about.title: Made in India, designed for the way people actually live.

storyBlocks.title: Origin
paragraphs: LEAFO is a planter manufacturer based in Gandhidham, Gujarat. We make fiber pots and full-size planters for homes, commercial spaces, and landscape projects.

The company started with a simple observation: India had hundreds of pot manufacturers, but very few thinking about planters as designed objects. Most catalogues offered shape, but not silhouette. Colour, but not finish. We started LEAFO to close that gap.

storyBlocks.title: Approach
paragraphs: Every series in the catalogue is drawn before it's moulded. Sizes are chosen so that a single design works at desktop scale and architectural scale. Finishes are tested for outdoor weather over multiple seasons. Production happens in our own facility, with hand-laying, hand-finishing, and quality control done in-house.

whatWeMake: Built for indoor and outdoor use
Shipped across India, exported on request
about.closing: If you're an architect, designer, hotelier, or homeowner working on a space, we'd like to hear what you're planning.
about.imageAlt: Row of LEAFO planters in varied finishes and plants against a sage-green slatted wall
